purpose: Detect cases where value already exists but cannot flow because counterparties cannot verify, value, control, trust or safely commit to it; separately record cases where a credible orchestrator absorbs market/access risk so distributed actors can participate.

evidence: In Xuzhou agricultural supply chains, inventory can become financeable after storage, warehouse-receipt evidence and bank-compatible control/verification are established.

A 2026 Xuzhou case reports warehouse-receipt lending around garlic inventory, with cumulative '仓单e贷' lending of about RMB 4 billion to 500+ dealers; the inventory existed before the loan, while the trusted representation made it acceptable collateral.
Xuzhou reported RMB 3.424 billion of intellectual-property pledge financing in 2025, benefiting 500+ SMEs.

A 2026 Xuzhou bank case replaced heavy reliance on factory/land collateral with IP, R&D-team strength, innovation qualifications and policy-award evidence, providing an RMB 8 million unsecured revolving facility to a specialized chemical-materials company.
Xuzhou's Data Regulation, effective 2026-07-01, explicitly supports data-asset valuation, accounting, investment contribution and pledge financing and encourages standardized data-flow services.

Xuzhou has already registered data intellectual property and established local transaction standards; public reporting describes data/IP registration and licensing/finance infrastructure as an existing institutional route rather than an absent capability.
findings.decision: Use as a cross-domain replication of verifiability transformation. Do not promote generic data-asset consulting without actor-level residual evidence.

evidence: ICBC Xuzhou reported supply-chain financing above RMB 7.2 billion by April 2026, with RMB 2.321 billion in inclusive-finance balance.
Its model explicitly maps core-enterprise supply relationships and transaction/settlement behavior and uses the core firm's commercial credit to extend finance to downstream/upstream SMEs.
findings.decision: Reference evidence for trust/legibility transformation, not a supply-chain-finance opportunity thesis.

evidence: A Jiawang village pet-cat project uses deposit adoption (or purchase), breeding support, veterinary/technical support and guaranteed repurchase.

Qualified kittens are promised 100% repurchase after defined age/weight/disease checks; participating households do not need to solve the final sales channel themselves and may return a healthy mother cat after two years under the published exit terms.
The launch reportedly attracted 26 households and two administrative villages.

Xuzhou agricultural industrialization publicly uses enterprise + cooperative + base + farmer structures, order purchasing, floor-price/dividend arrangements, secondary returns and equity cooperation to connect small farmers to markets.
A Xuzhou wheat-chain initiative combines finance, inputs/services, technical guidance and order repurchase with floor-price / quality-price protection.
findings.mechanism: FRAGMENTED_PRODUCTION_CAPACITY + MARKET/PRICE/SALES_RISK + CREDIBLE OFFTAKE/COORDINATION NODE -> DISTRIBUTED PRODUCTION FLOW
findings.boundary: Evidence is strong in agriculture and pet breeding; do not generalize to every distributed-work model without cross-sector replication.

evidence: Jiawang's plant-based cat-litter cluster uses soy/tofu residue, protein residue, corn starch and other plant/agricultural materials as production inputs; local reporting explicitly describes soybean residue being converted from waste into pet-product feedstock.
The cluster is already large and organized, so generic food/agriculture-byproduct-to-cat-litter matching is not whitespace.
findings.mechanism: LOW_VALUE_OR_BYPRODUCT_MATERIAL + ADJACENT_PROCESSABLE_DEMAND + STANDARDIZED PRODUCT USE -> CROSS_INDUSTRY RECOUPLING
findings.decision: Keep as residual-value / cross-industry recoupling archetype only. Do not infer a specific supplier-buyer link unless directly evidenced.

evidence: Historical Xuzhou inspection-center material reported hundreds of instruments per year being proxied to Nanjing/Suzhou when local legal testing capability was unavailable.
2026 public procurement also uses outside testing institutions, but outside supplier selection alone does not prove local capability absence; it may reflect procurement, scoring or capacity choices.
findings.search_rule: Separate FORCED_EXTERNAL_ROUTING (no local legal/technical capability) from NORMAL_EXTERNAL_PROCUREMENT (buyer choice). Only forced routing with current frequency/cost/delay is connection-pressure evidence.
findings.next_truth: Obtain current task/category-level residue: what Xuzhou firms still must send outside, why, how often, and what time/downtime/transport cost results.

mechanisms_extracted.name: VERIFIABILITY_TRANSFORMATION
mechanisms_extracted.pattern: resource/capability/value exists + counterparty cannot safely verify/value/control it + trusted representation/standard/evidence/custody makes it legible -> flow becomes possible
mechanisms_extracted.search_rule: Look for resources that actors already value internally but counterparties refuse to transact against until evidence, rights, standards, custody or trusted scoring are added.

mechanisms_extracted.name: RISK_BEARING_ORCHESTRATOR
mechanisms_extracted.pattern: distributed actor has usable capacity but cannot bear asset/market/access risk + credible orchestrator supplies standard/support/offtake/risk absorption -> capacity enters a network
mechanisms_extracted.search_rule: Seek non-agricultural cases where actors participate only after a third party commits demand/offtake, supplies assets, or absorbs a material downside.

mechanisms_extracted.name: FORCED_EXTERNAL_ROUTING_LEDGER
mechanisms_extracted.pattern: local actor has repeated bounded task + task leaves region because capability is genuinely absent + measurable routing cost/delay/downtime -> local capability frontier residue
